plan.question: Which single indicators and mechanism pairs improve existing geometric outcomes after an observed exit?
plan.population: pos=0 and te>=0; endpoint-specific resolved labels; real and pseudo separate; all cells and six contracts retained
plan.decision_information: dir known only after exit; old t0 covariates not refreshed; geometry/census as-of uncertified
families: log volume/time intensity and its change
plan.family_additions: Exit delay and mechanism pairs added after initial 12-feature results were inspected, following explicit user additions. All expanded results are exploratory, not an independent confirmation. No operational threshold promotion.
plan.models: cell historical baseline plus one covariate training-only quintile logodds adjustment; pairs use training-only tertile cross (up to9 groups). Clock uses historical category rates. Empty categories fallback to training prior. No hyperparameter search.
plan.weights: equal sessions, equal contracts within session, equal t0 anchors within contract-session, equal rows within anchor. Duplicates retained, not independent.
plan.validation: global chronological dates all6contracts; first40percent seed training; remaining60percent three forward blocks; one global-session embargo; no test labels fitted

endpoints.continuation: O2 one band height beyond exited edge before inside close; exclude exit bar; <=2000 same-session bars
endpoints.post_retest_exit_side: O3b first exit-side barrier versus inside-side barrier after future observed retest; retest bar excluded; <=2000 same-session bars

metrics: Brier reduction vs cell baseline; positive improves probability forecast, not profits
weighted AUC and increment vs same baseline
held-out diagnostic bucket rates; training edges change by fold, not an optimized entry rule
unavailable: total actual path length and exit-close displacement

export_semantics.amp: past200-bar high-low range at t0 in ticks
export_semantics.occ: fraction of last500 closes inside [L,H] at t0
export_semantics.vol_100/vol_occ: already natural log past100/past500 accumulated volume
export_semantics.dur_100/dur_occ: already natural log accumulated interbar nanoseconds, session-boundary gaps zeroed
export_semantics.h: H-L+1 declared band ticks, not actual exit distance

plan.profiling: Raw parquet generic profiler unsupported; exact hash/footer validation and native selected-column profile used; generic projected CSV profiles previously checked. Source warning is unsupported parsing, not evidence of corruption.

distance_addition.measurement: existing mx_h: max observed exit-side high/low excursion from exited edge divided by h; exit bar excluded; until first inside close or bounded same-session window ends; includes return-close bar high/low

reproduction.canonical_input: direct hash-pinned Parquet, not CSV projection

comparison_plan.question: Does exit context distinguish continuation, and is the pattern zone-specific?
comparison_plan.grain: forward block x cohort x training-defined mechanism bucket
comparison_plan.finding: Fast/high-range bucket exceeds slow/low-range bucket in all3blocks in BOTH cohorts
comparison_plan.derivation: bucket weighted positive mass / same bucket eligible weight
comparison_plan.reason: Keep all3 blocks and both cohorts visible, not a single attractive pooled contrast; two illustrated corners selected after exploration, all9 buckets retained in CSV

comparison_plan.question: Does normalization transfer across contracts?
comparison_plan.population: O2 real resolved eligible forward tests; only4contracts appear in test dates
comparison_plan.unit: mean Brier reduction x1000 over supported folds
comparison_plan.finding: Normalized range alone reverses in MNQ_12-26; joint delay/range positive but small there
comparison_plan.derivation: mean within-contract cell-baseline error minus feature error
comparison_plan.reason: Aggregate improvement hides a consequential negative subgroup; retain low support 10sessions

comparison_plan.question: Which tested mechanisms add the most predictive information?
comparison_plan.finding: 26 tests retained; best descriptive O2 joint delay/range, all26 negative mean O3b error improvements
comparison_plan.reason: Complete tested list and failures retained, no taller ranking of26groups

comparison_plan.reason: Research hypotheses and observable timing specified, no made-up peak result
